seo.meta_description: Chipotle serves Mexican-inspired food but is an American company founded in Denver. Here's the real story behind the 'Mexican Grill'.

question: Is Chipotle Actually Mexican?
quick_answer: Chipotle serves Mexican-inspired food, but it is an American company, not a Mexican one. It was founded in Denver, Colorado, in 1993, and its burritos, bowls and tacos are an Americanized, fast-casual take on Mexican flavors rather than traditional, regional Mexican cooking. So the food is Mexican-style; the chain is American.
key_facts: Chipotle is an American company, founded in Denver in 1993
The menu is Mexican-inspired, not traditional regional Mexican
Dishes like the burrito bowl are Americanized fast-casual versions
The name 'chipotle' is a real Mexican ingredient (a smoked chili)

body.heading: Mexican-inspired, American company
body.text: Chipotle's food draws clearly from Mexican cooking: burritos, tacos, salsas, guacamole, carnitas and barbacoa all come from that tradition. But Chipotle itself is an American company, founded in Denver, Colorado, so it is best described as Mexican-inspired rather than authentically Mexican.

body.heading: An Americanized style
body.text: The build-your-own burrito and bowl format, the large portion sizes, and items like the burrito bowl are fast-casual American inventions built on Mexican flavors. Traditional Mexican food varies hugely by region and often looks quite different from Chipotle's streamlined menu, so purists would call it Tex-Mex-leaning or Mexican-American.

body.heading: Where the name comes from
body.text: The word 'chipotle' is genuinely Mexican: it refers to a smoked, dried jalapeno chili used in Mexican cooking. So the name nods to real Mexican ingredients even though the company and its style are American.

faqs.a: It is Mexican-inspired rather than traditional Mexican. Chipotle is an American company serving an Americanized, fast-casual version of Mexican flavors.
Chipotle was founded in 1993 in Denver, Colorado, which is why it is considered an American company.
Chipotle is a Mexican word for a smoked, dried jalapeno chili used in Mexican cooking.
